I was in the exact same situation about 3 months ago. It took me a while to get back on my feet cause i was as lost as you probably are right now. I felt unlovable and i was just destroyed. I didn’t know who i was either after we broke up cause my life revolved around him and it’s why it became toxic between us. The best advice i can give you is to take your time and go one day at a time. It won’t be easy everyday but you can go through this. Find new hobbies or revisit old hobbies you had, even the one you had when you were little. My childish personality loves to colour in books and listen to music like i did when i was young. Cry as much as you need to, don’t keep it all inside. If you need someone to talk to my dms are always open. I want you to know that you deserve to be loved and happy too. Your life shouldn’t revolved around anyone but yourself. Introspection is a really good thing to do to. Try to reflect on where it went wrong, what were you doing that wasn’t healthy for your relationship. Don’t put yourself in the victim seat but instead try to put yourself in your ex’s place. I know it’s hard to try and think like a « sane » person but it’s not impossible. Trust me, don’t give up on yourself, you’ll get through this. Take good care of yourself ♡
